A.notes: A has a strong editorial-product idea: the numbered 32-cup contact sheet, specimen-style details, and kiln story all support the brief and make buying the featured item fast. Typography and layout are disciplined, though some mobile moments feel a bit tight; motion evidence is modest from the strip, with the firing timeline progression doing the most conceptual work.

B.notes: B is handsome and typographically confident, with a warm editorial tone and well-drawn product imagery. But it behaves more like a brand landing page than a fast product page, the motion strip shows little concept-carrying change beyond reveals/scroll progression, and the mobile/full-page captures suggest inconsistent rendering of the shop section.

raw.why: A answers the e-commerce brief more completely and distinctively, with faster product selection and a clearer link between the flame-mark story and the buying interface.
